name: HGB v4 (momentum + position efficiency)
description: v3 baseline for RB/TE (unchanged), plus KTC momentum + position-specific efficiency for QB/WR only. QB gets 30d/90d trend, momentum_ratio, max_games_missed_streak, prior_passing_tds, prior_interceptions. WR gets the same momentum features plus prior_targets, prior_red_zone_targets.
